claims.scope: balanced uniform Boolean functions; any C>2; any character-times-bent occurrence template
claims.statement: C(I-1)-H >= S_* - E_C + T(r) + K_occ >= S_* - E_C + T(r) + G(r), where E_C is the coordinatewise positive phi_C-loss relative to the template, T=sum_i h2(r_i)-H_max(r), and G is the fleet04/B17 balanced Booleanity-gap lower bound. Hence E_C <= S_*+T+G is a sufficient FEI-safety certificate with no ambient-alphabet entropy term.
